name: POSTAL
description:
POSTAL (1997) is the open-source release of the classic isometric shooter developed by Running With Scissors. Plunging players into dark, intense combat, this native port modernizes the classic title for Linux.

Features:
- Native execution on modern 64-bit Linux with high framerates and resolution scaling
- Complete classic campaign, Special Delivery expansion, and gauntlet challenge modes
- Dual-stick gamepad and keyboard/mouse control configurations
- Atmospheric sound effects, voice acting, and explosive weapon arsenal
- Preserves the gritty vintage aesthetic with improved engine stability
